phases.goal: Use short exact-prompt VLA chunks to place one bottle into the bin before moving to the next.
phases.name: place_first_bottle
phases.verify: The active bottle is visibly contained or stably entering the bin.

phases.goal: Continue bottle by bottle while preserving any bottle already placed in the bin.
phases.name: place_remaining_bottles
phases.verify: Previously placed bottles remain in the bin while the next bottle is manipulated.

phases.goal: Finish with a short exact-prompt VLA correction only if the current observation shows incomplete containment.
phases.name: final_containment_check
phases.verify: All target bottles are inside the bin at the official terminal state.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Handle one bottle at a time and re-observe after each short VLA chunk.
Verify containment before manipulating another bottle near the bin.
Do not splice in unlisted or observation-unbound analytic moves.

roles.protected: bottles already contained in the bin

task_language: Drop the bottle with small ridged green cap, the cylindrical bottle, and the red and black beverage bottle into the medium black garbage container, handling them one at a time.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 4:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 5:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 6:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 7:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 8:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 9:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 10:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 11:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: The selected success remains the pure short exact-prompt VLA attempt 001. Attempt 005 is only conditional evidence for one observation-bound lower move_to increment when geometry is collision-clear, followed by re-observation; it is not the default finisher.
